Commentary.Commentary: Right then, that is all we have from this game. West Indies have sealed this three-match ODI series with a win in this second ODI. However, there are still 10 World Cup Super League points up for grabs and both teams would be eager to get those points in their kitty. The third ODI is scheduled on 4th of June, Saturday and it will begin at 2.30 pm IST (9 am GMT). Our coverage though will start in advance. So do join us for the same. Till then, goodbye and cheers!

Nicholas Pooran, the West Indies skipper, says that he is very happy and they came here to win games and they are doing the right things. Tells that it was a good game and despite losing some wickets, the boys put their hands up and that’s what they want. Mention that they had conversations about taking early wickets and adds that even if they don’t get it, spinners have to do their job. Says that victory means a lot to them and they just want to keep winning and want to enjoy this win.

Pieter Seelaar, the Netherlands skipper, says they didn't bat well after having a good platform. Says their spinners got a good purchase. Adds that they let it slip after West Indies were restricted to 99/5 odd. On Shariz Ahmad, says it was a good outing for him. He feels that they drop off too early. Mentions that he is disappointed and they wanted to win but there are a lot of positives. Praises his bowlers for starting brightly.

Brandon King is the PLAYER OF THE MATCH for his brilliant unbeaten knock of 91 from 90 balls! He says he is happy so far, he tries to do his best for the team. Says the pitch is good for batting no doubt and fortunately their bowlers did a good job to bundle them out below-par. It was satisfying for him to help his team and get over the line.

Netherlands had a great start both with the bat and ball in this game but could not capitalize on either of them. There are lot of positives for them in this game with seamers and spinners bowling well and the top 3 batters batting well. However, if they want to win games against big teams they need to learn to seize the opportunities when they come their way and overall it was another good learning curve for the men in orange. They would be looking to cap off this series with a win in the next game.

The pitch was the one that aided spinners and Windies spinners took full advantage of it as they restricted Netherlands to 214 despite the Dutch getting off to a great start with 101 runs on the board with no wicket. Akeal Hosein was the star with the ball once again for the West Indies as he took four wickets. The men in maroon were though put on the back foot at the start of their batting innings and were restricted to 60-4 as their top order failed to get going on a difficult pitch. However, King was in his zone again and after a brief partnership with Mayers, Carty joined him. The duo put together an unbeaten stand of over 100 runs with King scoring 91 off 90 balls and on the way took his team over the line in the second game in the row.

West Indies have taken an unassailable lead of 2-0 in this three-match ODI series and have clinched 10 more crucial points in the World Cup Super League. They were made to toil hard but they have clinched this game comfortably in the end and these are encouraging signs for this young Windies team moving ahead as they look to build a team for the future. Netherlands, on the other hand, had their moments and at one point of time were in control of this game but this is ODI cricket and one needs to keep the consistency level for a longer time and that is where Dutch have fallen short again.

SIX! Keacy Carty finishes off in style! Shorter and on middle. Carty rocks back and smashes it high over the deep mid-wicket fence for a biggie. West Indies seal the series as they go 2-0 up and win this match by 5 wickets.
Slants a length ball on middle, tucked away to mid-wicket.
Flatter and around off. Carty punches it to mid off.
Around off, pushed to covers. West Indies are one hit away now.
Length and on off. King taps it back to the bowler.
FOUR! Misfield! A full ball, on middle. King whips it uppishly and to deep mid-wicket. Shariz Ahmad takes the charge and misjudges it and allows it through for a boundary.
Short in length and on middle. Carty pulls it to deep square leg for a single.
On a length and outside off. Carty opens the face of the bat but mistimes his dab to point.
A length ball, outside off. King drives it to sweeper cover for a single.
Flatter and quicker again, on off. Cary defends it towards the off side. 10 runs needed now!
On the shorter side and quicker on off. Carty goes back and blocks it.
A flatter one on middle. Carty defends it off the front foot.
Short and wide outside off. King cuts it to sweeper cover for a single.
Dropped! Short on off. King pulls it firmly and straight to Logan van Beek at mid-wicket. It comes very fast to him and he drops it again.
FOUR! On the shorter side on off. King goes back and lifts this straight down the ground for a boundary.
On a length, on middle. King works it towards mid-wicket for a single.

Ohh...this one almost took Logan van Beek's head off. It will go down as a drop chance but a very tough one, indeed. A length ball, on off. King hits it hard straight back to the bowler. Logan van Beek takes an evasive action and the the ball hits his hand and deflects towards the off side.
WIDE! Logan van Beek bangs it short on off. King lets it go as it is too high. The umpire signals it wide.
On the shorter side, around off. Carty opens the face of his blade and runs this ball down to third man for another single.
Back of a length, around off. King steers it towards third man for a single.
Lands on a length, on middle. King works it towards mid-wicket.
Angling on middle. Carty works it to deep square leg for a single.
Logan van Beek is back into the attack. 20 runs needed now.
Tossed up on off. Carty drives it to long off for a single. Just 20 needed now from 48 balls!
A flatter one on off. Carty pushes it to mid on.
A googly that is drifting on the pads. Carty works it towards deep backward square leg for a couple.
A flatter one on middle. Carty blocks it out.
Slower in the air, on off. King drives it to long off for a single.
Change of ball! A box full of balls arrives as a new ball is in need.
SIX! Ohh...this is huge! Out of the ground! A flighted delivery on off. King dances down the track and makes it a full toss. Tonks it straight down the ground for a biggie.
It is full and outside off. Carty looks to drive but misses. 30 needed now from 54 balls!
Shorter delivery on middle. King pulls it to deep backward square leg for a single.
SIX! What a shot! This is the talent of this man and he is finally showing that on the big stage! It is full and outside off. King drives it uppishly over deep extra-cover for a maximum.
Back of a length, around off. Carty dabs it towards backward point for a single.
On a length, around off. King defends it towards the off side for a single.
A fullish delivery, around off. Carty drives it towards deep extra cover and takes three runs.
Powerplay 3 time. One extra fielder, i.e. 5 can now be put outside the 30-yard circle till the end of this inning.
Shorter, outside off, steep bounce. King rocks back but the steep bounce makes his decision to change and he blocks it on the deck.
Full, flighted and outside off, driven to long off for a single.
Tossed up, on off, Carty leans and defends it to cover.
Slides one on the pads. Carty fails to hit it past the keeper.
Too outside off. Easy leave by Carty.
A length ball, on middle, googly. Carty opens his body and plays it back to the bowler.
Shariz Ahmad is back on.
On middle. King hits it to the left of the bowler who makes a good stop.
Another quick single! Length ball, on off. Carty knocks it to mid off and takes a quick single. The fielder misses his shy at the bowler's end.
A low dipping full toss, on middle. Carty digs it back to the bowler who shows some aggression by throwing it to the striker's end.
On a length and on middle. Carty flicks it to deep square leg for a couple of runs. Good running.
Three wides! Full, slower and down the leg side. Carty misses his flick. The ball bounces just in front of the keeper and he fumbles to collect it. Two runs.
Outside off, King runs it down to third man for a single.
Good start by Klein! A length ball, outside off, shaping away. King tries to push away from the body but misses.
Ryan Klein is back on. He has bowled five wicketless overs so far. Can he break this partnership?
Fuller and on middle, eased down to long on for a single.
An arm ball, sliding on the pads. Carty tucks it behind square for a single.
Tossed up, outside off. Carty drives it again to mid off.
Full and outside off, driven to mid off.
Now Carty stays back and hits this length ball back to the bowler.
Tossed up, on middle. Carty skips down only to block it back to the bowler.
Short of a length, on off. King pulls it through the diving mid-wicket fielder and collects a brace. 10 runs off it. 52 needed in 78 balls.
This is short and outside off. Carty tries to duck but is late in his action and the ball takes his hanging bat and luckily goes through the ground to point. A single.
TAP AND RUN! Length ball, outside off. King drops it to covers and takes off for a quick single.
Length ball, on middle. King whacks it through mid-wicket for a brace.
FOUR! TOP SHOT! Over-pitched, on middle. King gets a straight bat down and drives it past mid on for a boundary.
Fuller ball tailing on the pads. King misses his flick and gets hit on the pads.

DRINKS! These two have done well to soak in all the pressure and have now taken Windies to the safer shores. King has looked in supreme touch right from the word go and young Keacy Carty is also getting into his groove. Netherlands need to break this partnership as early as possible to stand any chance of winning this game. However, a wicket or two quickly here and Netherlands will be right back in this game. Can Bas de Leede provide that breakthrough? Here he is, back into the attack.
Flatter and on middle. King punches it through covers for a run.
Slides one, quicker and it stays low as well. King clips it to square leg.
An arm ball, slanting on off. Carty drills it to long on for a single.
Tossed up, on middle. King works it to deep mid-wicket for one run.
Full again on middle. King looks to wrists it away but ue ends it to mid-wicket.
Very full and outside off, it is pushed to long off for a single.
Overpitched on off. King drives it straight to the cover fielder.
A fullish length, outside off. Carty looks to drive it but gets the inside edge towards the leg side for a single.
Angling on the pads. King clips it to fine leg for a single.
Back-to-back fifties for Brandon King! Another solid knock under pressure! A fullish length, outside off. King carves it towards deep point and comes back for the second run.
Another full delivery, on off. Carty drives it to deep extra-cover for a single.
Fuller and around off. Carty drives it to covers.
Quicker and it is outside off. King drives it to covers.
Darted on off. King gets well forward and blocks it.
Tossed up on off. Carty drives it to long off for a single.
A flatter one on off. Carty blocks it out.
FOUR! Good use of feet! On middle and Carty dances down the track to hit it wide of and over mid on for a boundary.
A flatter one on off. Carty blocks it out.
On a length, on off. Carty looks to punch it away but gets the inside edge to fine leg for a single.
Back of a length, on off. King looks to pull but gets the inside edge onto the pads. It brushes the pads and goes towards the leg side for a single.
On a length, on middle. Carty works it to mid-wicket for a single.
On a length, around off. King pushes it towards the off side and sets off for a single. There is a shy at the bowler's end but missed and King completes the single.
WIDE! A fullish delivery and down the leg side. King looks to clip it but misses.
FOUR! Good shot! Short ball on off. King pulls it towards deep backward square leg for a boundary.

Ohh...terrible mix-up between the batters but Netherlands have messed up a big opportunity. A fullish delivery on middle. King pushes it to mid on and first sets off for a single. However, he decides to sent his partner back who is halfway down the pitch till that time. The fielder at mid on has a shy at the bowler's end but misses. Musa Ahmad coming in close to the stumps also fails to collect it and Keacy Carty comes back to his crease.
Slower and fuller on off. Keacy Carty blocks it off the front foot.
On the shorter side on off. King gets low and sweeps it to deep square leg for a single.
An arm ball on middle. King blocks it from his crease.
Goes fuller on middle. King works it towards the leg side.
A flatter delivery on off. King blocks it out.
Short and wide outside off. Carty cuts it to sweeper cover for a single.
Overpitched delivery on off. King drives it straight to mid off. 87 more needed from 114 balls!
Sticks with the same length, on off. King defends it off the front foot.
Serves a length ball, on middle. King defends it solidly.
On a length, around off. Carty guides it to third man for a single.
FOUR! Good timing there! Overpitched delivery on off. Keacy Carty drives it through covers for a boundary.
Lands on a length, on off. Keacy Carty blocks it off the front foot.
Flatter and spinning around off. King punches off the back foot to covers. Dot to end but a good over for the visitors.
Tossed up, on off. King blocks it out to covers.
SIX! Brandon King is taking on the youngsters! This is full and in the slot. King kneels and slogs it over cow corner for a biggie.
This one stays low, fuller and on middle. King clears his front leg and keeps it out.
Flatter and outside off, pushed to covers.
FOUR! Welcome boundary! Not a good delivery this! Shorter and outside off. King rocks back and pulls it in the gap, to deep mid-wicket for a boundary.
Pitched up, on middle. Carty drives it straight to mid on this time.
Just a single! Boundaries have dried up for the Windies! Length and on middle, pushed to the left of mid on where Vikramjit Singh makes a tumbling stop.
Fuller and on off, it is hit to covers. Four dots now
Length ball, on middle. King stays back and turns it to mid-wicket.
Around off, on a length. Blocked out.
Length ball, outside off. King shoulders arms to it.
Slants it on the pads, flicked to square leg. Just three of it.
Full again, outside off. Carty drives it but straight to the cover fielder.
Fuller ball on middle. Carty pushes it to mid on.
Wide! Down the leg side, fuller. Carty misses his flick.
Quicker one on the pads. King whips it to square leg for a single.
Floated, around offf. Carty leans and drives it to covers for a single.
Shorter and outside off, cut away to point.
Length ball, on off. Blocked to covers.
Short of a length and on off. King miscues his defense completely and the ball drops on the deck.
Short in length and on middle, it is pulled away to deep square leg for a single.
Length ball, outside off. Kept out.
On a length and outside off. Carty drops it to cover.
A length ball on middle. King drives it but it goes off the inner edge to deep square leg for a single.
Logan van Beek is back on.
Short again, outside off. Carty punches it to cover.
Two googlies and now a leggie, shorter and outside off. Carty hangs back and defends on the wrong line. Superb bowling display from the youngster.
Another googly, on middle. Carty rocks back and keeps it out on the leg side.
A googly, on middle. King tucks it behind square on the leg side for a single.
A flighted full toss, on middle. Carty drives it past the bowler and to long on for a single.
Tossed up, around off, pushed to mid off.
Ryan Klein continues with the fullish length, outside off. Keacy Carty drives it to sweeper cover for a single. He is off the mark.
A half-volley on off. King drives it to long off for a single.
Fullish delivery on off. King drives it towards the extra-cover region.
FOUR! Nicely timed by King! Shot of a man in form! Shorter in length and outside off. King cuts it past point for a boundary.
Pitched up, on off. King drives it straight to the cover fielder in the ring.
Back of a length, around off. King dabs it towards point.
Pushed quicker and around  off. Keacy Carty looks to cut but gets no timing there.
A googly on off. Keacy Carty goes back and blocks it out.
Slower in the air, on off. Keacy Carty drives it to covers.
A flatter one on middle. Keacy Carty pushes it to mid on.
Keacy Carty walks out.

OUT! CAUGHT BEHIND! The youngster has done it! Strikes in his second ball and West Indies lose their fifth wicket! Shariz Ahmad pushes it quicker and around off. It is on the shorter side again but keeps a bit low and it's a googly again. Mayers gets an underedge of his blade as he looks to cut and Scott Edwards behind the stumps takes a sharp catch. Big wicket!
Commentary.Howout: c Scott Edwards b Shariz Ahmad

Commentary.Commentary: The youngster starts with a googly around off. Slightly shorter in length. Mayers looks to cut but gets an outside edge past the keeper. Batters run two.
Shariz Ahmad on his debut, to bowl now.
Shorter in length, around leg. King pulls it wide of short fine leg for a couple.
A tossed up delivery on off. King blocks it off the front foot.
Darts it on leg. Mayers works it to backward square leg for a single.
FOUR! Powerful shot by Mayers! This will ease some pressure! Shorter in length and around off. Mayers goes back and slaps it hard over the infield towards the extra-cover boundary.
A fuller delivery, around off. King drives it to sweeper cover for a single.
A fuller one on off. King blocks it off the front foot.
Slower in the air, on off. Mayers blocks it off the front foot.
Good change of pace! He bowls this one quick and flat on middle. King works it to mid-wicket for a single.
Dutt goes fuller on middle. Mayers works it to mid-wicket for a single.
Pushed quicker on off and flatter. Mayers blocks it out.
A fuller delivery on off. Mayers drives it to covers.
Tossed up, outside off. Mayers punches it off the back foot to deep cover and collects a brace.
An arm ball, sliding on middle. King prods and blocks it out.
Fuller and outside off, driven to covers for a single.
Flatter and on off. Blocked out.
FOUR! Good shot! Shorter in length, on off. Mayers goes back and pulls it towards deep mid-wicket for a boundary.
A flatter one on off. Mayers blocks it out.
On the shorter side on off. King pulls it right of Pieter Seelaar. The ball goes aerially but wide of the bowler as Pieter Seelaar looks to catch it. He fails to reach it and a single is taken.
Flighted ball, full and on leg. Mayers leans and blocks it out. West Indies need 136 more runs to win.
Keeps it short and outside off. King pulls it to long on for one.
Floated, around off. Mayers strokes it to deep cover for a single.
Dutt angles it on the pads, Mayers punches it to mid on this time.
This one comes with the angle, on off. Mayers pushes it to covers.
Half-tracker, outside off. King eases it to long on for a single.
Flatter ball, outside off. Mayers punches it through covers. Slow outfield means the fielder can chase it out. Two runs.
Short and spinning into Mayers. He rocks back and punches it straight to the man at covers.
Tossed up, on middle. King wrists it to square leg for a single.
Around middle, it is flicked to mid-wicket.
Fuller and around middle. King drives it back to the bowler off the cue end of the bat.
Length ball on off.  Mayers punches it to covers for a single.
Pieter Seelaar is into the attack now.
This one holds on the surface. King punches it back to Dutt.
FOUR! Good shot! Too full and too wide. King drives it past point for a boundary.
Tossed up, on off. Defended to cover.
Slanting on the pads. Mayers rocks on the back foot to tuck it in front of square for a single.
Length and on off. Blocked out.
Pushes it quicker, on middle, it skids on late. Kyle looks to defend but gets an inside edge to short fine leg.
FOUR! Boundary to end the over! King is in good form and he needs to make sure that he bats till the end. A full toss, on off, it is driven through mid off for a boundary.
On middle, tucked to mid-wicket.
Length ball, on middle. Mayers tries to play it late under his eyes but inner edges it to short fine leg for a single.
Full straight and drifting on the pads. Mayers fails to dig it out. Netherlands think of taking it upstairs but stays against the decision.
On a length and on off. Mayers nudges it on the leg side.
Wide! Short but down the leg side. Mayers lets it through.
Very full and on off, pushed to covers.
Outside off. Mayers punches off the back foot to point for a single.

DRINKS! What a spirited bowling performance this has been so far by the Dutch. They are defending a below-par total but have managed to get rid of four Windies batters with just 60 runs on the board. We all saw in the first innings that it became tougher to bat when the spinners came on and now West Indies have a tough task in front of them and need a partnership to take this game deep. Kyle Mayers walks out to the middle now and Netherlands will be hoping to keep their good work going.

OUT! CHOPPED ON! Aryan Dutt gets the better of Nicholas Pooran for the second time! He gets the big fish yet again! Flatter, outside off. Pooran gets low and looks to drive it away but the ball takes the inside edge before hitting the stumps. Nicholas Pooran walks back in disbelief. He was looking good today. Netherlands right on top in this game.
Tossed up, around off. Pooran blocks it off the front foot.
Another good shot but for no run! Shorter and outside off, cut away to point.
SIX! BANG! Dutt drops it short and on middle. It sits nicely for Pooran to pull it all the way over deep mid-wicket for a biggie.
A flatter ball, outside off. King dabs it to short third man for a single.
This is a fullish length, around off. Pooran pushes it to covers.
On a length and around off. King punches it to mid off for a single.
Fuller and around off. King drives it to covers.
On the shorter side and around off. King looks to punch it away but gets no timing on this one.
Back of a length, on off. King defends it towards mid off.

FOUR! Beautifully played! A fullish delivery, around off. It is not an half-volley by any stretch of imagination but King drives it on the up and through covers crisply. The fielder in the ring runs behind it and makes a good slide near the ropes but fails to keep it inside the playing area.
Tossed up, around off. Pooran defends it towards the off side off the front foot. Maiden over!
A flatter and slightly shorter one on off. Pooran cuts it to backward point.
Slower in the air, on middle. Pooran works it to mid-wicket.
A flatter one on middle. Pooran plays it back to the bowler.
On the shorter side and flatter on off. Pooran punches it to covers.
Tossed up on off. Pooran blocks it off the front foot.
Brandon King is the new man in.

OUT! LBW! Bas de Leede strikes and gets rid of Nkrumah Bonner! West Indies are in a spot of bother here! Bas de Leede lands this one a length, on off and it nips back in. Bonner looks to work it towards the leg side but misses. The ball hits his pads and there is a big appeal. It looks dead plumb and the umpire raises his finger! Bonner walks back and game on here!
Bangs it short on off. Pooran pulls it to deep square leg for a single.
Serves a length delivery, around off. Pooran leaves it alone.
Bas de Leede hits the length hard, it is around off. Pooran rides the bounce and punches it through covers for a couple.
A fullish delivery on off. Pooran defends it towards the off side and looks for a single but is sent back.
On a length, on off. Pooran with a solid block from his crease.

Just two runs from the over and this has been a good start from Dutt! Pitches it around off and it turns into Bonner a bit. He looks to reverse-sweep it but gets hit on his gloves and the falls back on the turf.
Slower in the air, on off. Bonner defends it towards the leg side.
Pushed quicker and flatter on middle. Bonner goes back and works it towards the leg side.
Short and wide outside off. Pooran cuts it to sweeper cover for a single.
Fuller on off and middle. Bonner reverse-sweeps it to towards point for a single.
A flatter delivery on off. Bonner pushes it to mid on.
Aryan Dutt is into the attack now.
Another good over from Bas de Leede! Back of a length, around off. Pooran punches it to mid off.
Bas de Leede angles it on leg from 'round the wicket. Pooran flicks it to the mid-wicket fielder.
On a length, on off. Pooran blocks it off the front foot.
Good delivery! Lands on a good length and around off. Pooran looks to push it away but the ball beats the outside edge of his blade and goes back to the keeper.
Lands on a length, on off. Pooran blocks it out.
WIDE! A fullish delivery but drifting down the leg side. Pooran looks to clip it but misses.
Back of a length, on leg. Bonner clips it to fine leg for a single.
Time for Powerplay 2! Now a maximum of 4 fielders can be placed outside the ring till the 40th over.
On the pads, it is flicked to mid-wicket.
On middle, on a length. Blocked out.
Angling on the hips, nudged past square leg for a single.
On a length and on off. Bonner steps down and tucks it to mid-wicket.
Length ball, angling on the pads. Bonner misses his clip and gets hit on the pads.
FOUR! Beautiful shot! Fuller and on middle. Bonner shows full face of the bat as he drives it past mid on for a boundary.

A half hearted appeal for caught behind but not given! Slants a full ball, down the leg side. Pooran looks to flick it away but misses and the ball brushes the thigh pads as it goes to the keeper. Confirms the replay as well.
Wide! Length ball down the leg side. Pooran misses his flick.
Nicholas Pooran is the next man in.

OUT! TIMBER! What a ripper from Bas de Leede and he strikes in his first over! Lands it on a length and around off, good seam position here, it nips back in sharply. Shai Hope looks to work it away without any foot movement but gets squared up as the ball makes a huge movement. It sneaks through and shatters the stumps.
Fuller and on off. Hope blocks it out on the deck.
FOUR! Cracked away! A length ball too outside off. Hope has enough room to cut this past backward point for a boundary.
On top of off. Hope drops it to covers.
Short of a length, outside off. Bonner dabs it on the up to third man for a single.
Bas de Leede is into the attack now.
Too full and tailing on the pads. Bonner whips it to deep mid-wicket for a single.
Length ball, just outside off. Bonner looks to defend but it goes off the splice to backward point.
Outside off, on a length. Bonner keeps it out.
Short in length angling on the hips Bonner keeps it out around the corner on the leg side.
Good shot this! Fuller ball on off. Bonner drives it firmly through covers for a couple of runs.
A length ball, around off, it nips back in as well. Bonner looks to defend but misses and gets rapped on the pads.
A length ball, on the pads. Hope whacks it behind square on the leg side for a brace.
Length and on middle. Blocked out.
Length and on off. Hope taps it to cover.
Well bowled! On a length and in the channel of uncertainity, around off. Hope is made to play at it and he gets beaten on the outside edge.
Length and on top of off. Hope strokes it to point.
FOUR! Delightful! This is full and on middle. Hope drives it beautifully through extra-cover for a boundary.
An outswinger to end the over, fuller and outside off. Bonner leaves it.
Too full and outside off. Bonner looks to drive but it shapes away after landing. He misses.
FOUR! Bonner is off the mark! A length ball, steep bounce on middle. Bonner swivels and pulls it to deep square leg for a boundary. Sits nicely for him and makes the most of it.
A length ball, outside off. Bonner opens the face of the bat and dabs it to backward point.
On a length and outside off. Bonner looks to defend inside the line and misses.
Nkrumah Bonner walks in at number 3.

OUT! EDGED AND GONE! Just what Netherlands wanted, an early wicket. Logan van Beek serves a length ball, outside off and makes it to shape away. Brooks tries to break the shackles as he tries to punch it with hard hards but only manages to get a thick outside edge to first slip where Pieter Seelaar takes it nicely to his right. The Dutch are off to a great start.
Commentary.Howout: c Pieter Seelaar b Logan van Beek

Commentary.Commentary: A single to end the over and this has been a disciplined start by the Dutch bowlers! On a length, on off. Brooks defends it with soft hands towards covers and takes a quick single.
A fullish delivery on middle. Brooks drives it left of mid off.
Pulls his length back, on middle. Brooks works it towards mid-wicket.
Serves a full ball, on off. Brooks drives it to mid off this time.
Fuller and around off. Brook defends it towards mid on.
Back of a length, around off. Brooks blocks it towards the point.

FOUR! Lucky boundary for Hope! Excellent over by Logan van Beek though! Lands on a length and around off. Hope looks to cut it but the ball comes back in and catches the inside edge of Hope's blade. It goes past the stumps and beats the diving keeper for a boundary.
Back of a length and around off. Hope cuts it to short cover.
Serves a length delivery and outside off. Hope looks to drive it away from his body but misses.
Another delivery that jags back in! On a length and pitches on the off stump line. Hope looks to work it towards the leg side but misses and gets hit on the pads again.
Lands on a length, on off and it nips back in sharply. Hope looks to clip it away but the ball comes back and hits him high on the pads.
Slightly short and outside off. Brooks steers it towards deep backward point for a single.
Back of a length, on middle. Brooks works it to deep square leg for a single.
On a length and around off. Hope guides it towards third man for a single.
A fuller delivery on middle. Hope flicks it through mid-wicket for a couple.

Ohh...direct-hit and Brooks was a goner there! A fullish delivery on middle. Brooks defends it right of mid on and looks for a single. The fielder there collects the ball and has a shy at the bowler's end but misses. A single in the end.
A fullish delivery on off. Hope drives it left of mid off for a single.
On a length, on middle. Brooks works it to fine leg for a single.
WIDE! Ryan Klein drifts down the leg side. Brooks looks to work it away but it is down the leg side and he fails to connect.

A fullish delivery and wider outside off. Brooks throws his bat at it. The ball takes the thick outside edge of his blade towards third man for a single. First run off the bat and Brooks is off the mark.
Back of a length, around off. Brooks dabs it towards backward point.
Another delivery that is pitched on a length, on off. Brooks defends it.
On a length, on off. Brooks with a solid block from his crease.
WIDE! It is full but drifts down the leg side again. Brooks looks to flick it but misses.
WIDE! So first run of the innings comes off with a wide. Back of a length and around leg. Brooks looks to clip it but misses.
A fullish delivery, around off. Brooks drives and drives it crisply but Max O'Dowd dives and makes a good stop at overs.
Starts off with a good-length delivery, outside off. Brooks leaves it alone.
Who will bowl from the other end? It is Logan van Beek.
Ryan Klein starts off with a maiden! Back of a length, on off. Hope stays tall and punches it to covers.
Nice shape there for Ryan Klein! He delivers this full and it shapes into middle and leg. Hope looks to work it towards the leg side off the inside half of his blade.
Back of a length and around off. Hope rides the bounce and dabs it towards point.
Goes full on middle. Hope works it towards mid on.
Pulls his length back a bit, on off. Hope blocks it off the back foot.
Ryan Klein starts with a full delivery that drifts on the pads. Hope flicks it to mid-wicket.
